squats.name: Squats
form_cues: Keep feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Descend until thighs are at least parallel to the floor (knee angle ~90°).
Keep your chest upright and avoid letting your knees collapse inward (valgus).
Drive through your midfoot and heels on the way up.
common_mistakes: Rushing reps without achieving full depth

pushups.name: Pushups
form_cues: Maintain a straight plank line from head to heels.
Elbows should flare at approximately 45 degrees, not 90 degrees.
Lower chest to within 2 inches of the floor before pressing up to full elbow lockout.
Engage glutes and abs to avoid sagging hips.
common_mistakes: Sagging lower back or elevated hips
Partial reps not touching full depth

knee_raises.name: Knee Raises
form_cues: Drive knee upwards until thigh is parallel or slightly above hip level (angle < 80°).
Land lightly on the ball of the foot with soft knees.
Keep your torso upright; avoid leaning backward.
Maintain a brisk, steady cadence.
common_mistakes: Not raising knees high enough (shallow reps)

lunges.name: Lunges
form_cues: Take a generous stride forward.
Lower until both front and back knees reach 90-degree angles.
Front knee should not shear past toes.
Keep torso upright and core brace active.
common_mistakes: Back knee banging on the floor

plank.name: Plank
form_cues: Forearms parallel on floor, elbows aligned directly beneath shoulders.
Form a rigid straight line from shoulders to heels.
Squeeze glutes and pull belly button towards spine.
Breathe steadily without letting hips hike or dip.

jumping_jacks.name: Jumping Jacks
form_cues: Start standing upright with feet together and arms at sides.
Jump feet outward while sweeping arms above head.
Land softly on balls of feet with knees slightly unlocked.
Immediately reverse motion in rhythm.

bicep_curls.name: Bicep Curls
form_cues: Pin elbows firmly beside your ribs throughout the entire movement.
Curl weight upwards smoothly without swinging torso.
Pause and squeeze at peak contraction for 1 second.
Control the lowering eccentric phase for 2 seconds.
common_mistakes: Using momentum or swinging lower back

shoulder_press.name: Shoulder Press
form_cues: Press weight straight overhead until arms are extended but not hyper-extended.
Keep core tight to prevent overarching the lumbar spine.
Lower under control to chin/collarbone level.
common_mistakes: Pressing weight forward instead of overhead

sit_ups.name: Sit Ups
form_cues: Bend knees at 90 degrees with feet flat on the floor.
Cross arms over chest or keep hands by ears without pulling on the neck.
Engage abs to curl upper torso off the floor smoothly.
Lower back down with control.
common_mistakes: Using hip momentum instead of abdominal contraction

fat_loss.calorie_target: Daily caloric deficit of 300 - 500 kcal below TDEE.
fat_loss.protein_intake: 1.6 to 2.2 grams per kg of body weight.
fat_loss.hydration: 35 to 40 ml of water per kg of body weight daily.
fat_loss.advice: Prioritize high-volume fibrous veggies, lean poultry, fish, eggs, and complex slow-digesting carbs.

muscle_gain.calorie_target: Slight surplus of 250 - 400 kcal above maintenance TDEE.
muscle_gain.protein_intake: 1.8 to 2.4 grams per kg of body weight.
muscle_gain.hydration: 40 ml of water per kg of body weight daily.
muscle_gain.advice: Ensure adequate carbohydrate intake around training windows to fuel workouts and glycogen replenishment.

maintenance.protein_intake: 1.2 to 1.6 grams per kg of body weight.
maintenance.advice: Focus on whole foods, healthy fats (avocados, nuts, olive oil), and micronutrient variety.
